canonical_claim: Let n >= 2 and let X be a pointed, path-connected space whose homotopy groups pi_i(X) vanish for 1 <= i < n. Then reduced integral homology vanishes below n and the Hurewicz homomorphism pi_n(X) -> H_n(X; Z) is an isomorphism. The n = 1 abelianization statement is a related boundary case, not part of the selected root.

domain_and_universes: A pointed topological space X and a natural degree n; precise universe and separation/CW hypotheses remain source/API decisions.
quantifiers: For all n >= 2, pointed spaces X satisfying the frozen connectivity hypotheses, and degrees i < n.
hypotheses: pi_i(X) vanishes for every 1 <= i < n
any additional CW-type or local hypotheses required by the selected exact source are still to be audited
conclusion: Reduced integral homology vanishes in degrees below n and the nth Hurewicz homomorphism is an isomorphism.

alternate_encodings.target: X is (n-1)-connected implies reduced homology vanishes below n and the nth Hurewicz map is an isomorphism

A statement assuming the desired isomorphism as structure data is excluded.
